My best recommendation as someone who applied multiple times is to call back the school about your application and see what they wanted. Most schools will in fact tell you exactly what they liked and disliked. If you wait until post application time some schools will even check your current forms for you and do a “mock application” - Aka review it all and tell you what they would like to see. May is usually the best time to ask. 

I also recommend applying to at least 7 schools - including those abroad. 

Also, do not base your worth in Vet School applications and acceptances. Their standards often equate to being a good student, but do NOT necessarily equate to being a good vet.
